data.name: Royalton Grenada, An Autograph Collection All-Inclusive Resort
data.address: Magazine Beach Point Salines, St George's, Grenada
data.description:
This sleek all-inclusive beachfront resort is less than 1 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport, 16 km from Annandale Falls and 20 km from Grand Etang National Park/Lake.
Chic rooms, some with beach views, offer Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minibars, plus coffeemakers and terraces. The 1- to 4-bedroom suites add separate living areas; 1 has a kitchenette and an outdoor soaking tub. Club-level suites feature butler service, and access to a lounge with a private beach area. Room service is 24/7.
Meals and drinks are included at 5 restaurants and 6 bars. There's also an outdoor pool, a spa and a fitness center, plus a kids' club and watersports.
